issues.quote: Félix carries his father's silver watch and has never let anyone touch it, my husband included.
issues.fact: The fact sheet says only that Félix's watch showed twenty minutes to nine at the nine o'clock bell. It says nothing about the watch's ownership, its material, or whether anyone had handled or altered it.
issues.misreading: A solver could take the claim that no one ever touched the watch as confirmation that the 8:40 reading is reliable and was not tampered with, which would make Félix's watch a trustworthy reference point. The sheet gives no basis for that, so the reliability of the reading is unsettled.
